title: Vietnamese Nem Nuong
description: A popular Vietnamese dish featuring grilled pork patties served with rice and fresh herbs. Nem nuong is often served as a street food in Vietnam.
instructions: Prepare the pork mixture by combining ground pork, fish sauce, grated ginger, and lime juice in a bowl.
Mix well until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
Divide the pork mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Shape each ball into a patty.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the patties for about 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the Vietnamese bread by grilling it for a few minutes or baking it in the oven.
Assemble the nem nuong by placing a cooked patty on a toasted bread, followed by a spoonful of nem sauce, some fresh cilantro, and a sprinkle of toasted peanuts.
